initialRequests.name: conveyor
initialRequests.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create a PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS for a mobile TOP-DOWN square-grid ranch puzzle. Attached image is ONLY a material/style reference and shows an OLD DESIGN that must be substantially redesigned for movement readability.
Camera is fixed overhead, orthographic, square top surfaces with a SHORT front edge towards screen BOTTOM. Light always upper-left for EVERY direction. Draw each direction freshly; do NOT simply rotate a finished 2.5D sprite and its lighting. Crisp thick near-black NAVY outer contours, thinner sparse inside lines, angular straight segments, trapezoids, wedges; matte pale wood, ochre rope, a little sage-green/clover, yellow straw as small accents only. Broad SOLID flat color planes with ONLY base+ONE hard polygon shadow per material, optional small flat cream top plane. NO gradients, airbrush, glow, noisy woodgrain, fuzzy straw, filigree, glossy volume, 3D rendering. Low-profile and easily walkable. Alpha transparency in all empty space; no baked ground square, background, drop shadow, character, text, labels, grid lines or watermark. Every frame must remain safely inside its atlas cell with generous consistent transparent margins. Frames must have conspicuous real shape/position differences while frame size and anchors remain stable.
Exactly SIXTEEN isolated sprites in a precise 4 COLUMNS ×4 ROWS grid. Each ROW is one direction; its FOUR COLUMNS are animation phase 0/1/2/3 left to right. ROW1 EAST: motion and ALL large printed arrows point RIGHT. ROW2 NORTH: motion and ALL arrows point UP. ROW3 WEST: motion and ALL arrows point LEFT. ROW4 SOUTH: motion and ALL arrows point DOWN.
Redesign the old conveyor so the narrow wood/rope GUARD RAILS run PARALLEL to travel and never block the two entry/exit edges. EAST/WEST rows: rails on top and bottom, open left/right ends, vertical slats inside. NORTH/SOUTH rows: rails on left and right, open top/bottom ends, horizontal slats inside. The central usable belt lane must be at least 60% of the tile width. Short rail thickness at most 14% of a tile. One or two very large solid cream arrows/chevrons on the broad flat ochre slats, absolutely correct row direction.
For each row, visibly ADVANCE the slat seams and printed arrow/chevron pattern ONE QUARTER of a repeating cycle along the actual row motion direction from column0 to1 to2 to3. Keep the fixed outer rails identical across phases. Each of the four arrow positions must clearly change, not four identical copies. No decorative flowers inside travel lane. All sixteen objects similar apparent size, square 1-cell footprints.

Exactly SIXTEEN isolated low gate sprites in a precise 4 COLUMNS ×4 ROWS grid. Each ROW is a permitted actual displacement; the FOUR COLUMNS show opening sequence CLOSED, 30-DEGREE OPEN, 60-DEGREE OPEN, FULLY OPEN. All posts stay at the exact same positions in the four frames.
ROW1 EAST/right travel: two small posts at NORTH and SOUTH edges; the closed barrier connects north-to-south across the middle. A large cream arrow points RIGHT. Gate blades fold towards the RIGHT/east side. Final frame exposes a completely transparent central horizontal passage at least 60% of tile height.
ROW2 NORTH/up travel: posts at WEST and EAST edges; closed barrier across middle left-to-right. Arrow UP. Blades fold towards the TOP/north side. Final frame transparent central vertical passage at least60% tile width.
ROW3 WEST/left travel: posts at NORTH and SOUTH edges; closed barrier north-to-south. Arrow LEFT. Blades fold LEFT/west. Final frame clear horizontal passage at least60% tile height.
ROW4 SOUTH/down travel: posts at WEST and EAST edges; closed barrier left-to-right. Arrow DOWN. Blades fold BOTTOM/south. Final frame clear vertical passage at least60% tile width.
Use very slender pale wooden gate blades, small faceted sage post caps and tiny rope hinge bindings. NOT bulky fence walls, no diagonal support strut across the open lane, no plank floor filling gaps. The final open frame must retain BOTH complete posts and the two complete folded blades outside the central passage. Make angle changes large and unmistakable. All arrows must retain the corresponding permitted row direction on the blades. Fixed camera, do not turn the whole image and its shadows.

Every frame must remain safely inside its atlas cell with generous consistent transparent margins. Frames must have conspicuous real shape/position differences while frame size and anchors remain stable.
Exactly TWELVE isolated bounce-corner sprites in a precise 3 COLUMNS ×4 ROWS grid. Each ROW is an actual different CORNER orientation; THREE COLUMNS are REST, IMPACT/COMPRESS, REBOUND/RETURN. ROW1 NORTH-EAST corner: a thin L rail only along TOP and RIGHT tile edges. ROW2 NORTH-WEST: only TOP and LEFT edges. ROW3 SOUTH-WEST: only BOTTOM and LEFT edges. ROW4 SOUTH-EAST: only BOTTOM and RIGHT edges.
CRITICAL: discard the old bulky solid log/hay L-shaped block. Replace it with TWO SLENDER LOW WOODEN EDGE RAILS forming a shallow ㄴ/L outline, each rail no wider than 14% of the tile. The rails occupy only the outer edge strips. The large central 60%×60% square must remain completely TRANSPARENT, no floor slab, no log, hay bale, platform, panel, decorative leaves or filled center. At the meeting corner, add a compact 45-degree diagonal deflector face, matte straw pad with one cream diagonal highlight. This diagonal is only at the outside corner, not stretched across the whole tile. Top/right corner deflects a right-moving object DOWN and an up-moving object LEFT; top/left deflects left-moving DOWN and up-moving RIGHT; bottom/left deflects left-moving UP and down-moving RIGHT; bottom/right deflects right-moving UP and down-moving LEFT.
Across columns: REST rails thin with relaxed small corner pad; IMPACT corner pad visibly compressed inward, short rail flex about5% of tile; REBOUND pad restored/outward with two tiny angular impact accent strokes located OUTSIDE the central lane. No large transport arrows or signs in the central lane; a tiny bent direction mark can sit on the corner pad itself. Rails remain slim and low in all frames, central travel area must stay empty. All four corners independently drawn with the same fixed top-down camera and bottom-facing short edge.

Exactly SIX isolated brake-plate sprites in a precise 3 COLUMNS ×2 ROWS grid. Each ROW is an axis, and THREE COLUMNS show PRESS, HELD/COMPRESSED, RELEASE/RETURN. This device ENDS forced movement at its cell; it never carries, pushes or reverses an object.
ROW1 HORIZONTAL travel left/right: two short, broad, clearly separated CREAM STOP CROSSBARS drawn VERTICALLY, perpendicular to horizontal travel. ROW2 VERTICAL travel up/down: two CREAM STOP CROSSBARS drawn HORIZONTALLY, perpendicular to vertical travel. The two crossbars are the strongest graphic marks. Absolutely NO ARROWS, NO chevrons, NO bent arrow, NO wind streak, NO transport pictograms anywhere.
Use a very low, flat, sparse sage/ochre straw grip patch or shallow wood friction bed; no tall rails, no cage, no thick hay bale. Keep it passable on foot with a broad central lane. Frame1 PRESS: both stops still raised a little with short bottom faces; frame2 HELD: both crossbars noticeably sunk/flattened, dark navy rectangular seam exposed and straw compacted; frame3 RELEASE: crossbars spring back slightly higher with two small cream tick accents OUTSIDE the working center. These three are visibly distinct shapes/positions. Same footprint, center and overall base width across the row. The vertical travel version is separately painted with fixed bottom-facing front edge and upper-left light, not simply rotated.

selectedCorrections.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw this atlas as a SQUARE CANVAS with exactly4 COLUMNS ×4 ROWS of EQUAL SQUARE CELLS. Each conveyor must be an almost SQUARE 1-tile deck, same apparent 1:1 footprint for ALL directions. Do NOT draw wide short horizontal belts or narrow tall vertical belts. All sixteen conveyor outlines should be about the same square size and shape. Overhead camera, square top with only a very short bottom face; no oblique or isometric tilt.
Keep matte cream/ochre ranch wood with tiny sage corner caps, thick crisp angular navy contours and broad flat2tone colors; no gradients/noise/glow. Two very slender straight wooden guard rails only8% tile wide run PARALLEL to travel. Central USABLE BELT LANE must occupy at least70% tile width between rails, so a whole character can stand there. Open entry and exit edges; no end crossbar blocking travel. Remove all clovers or ropes sticking into the working lane.
ROW1 EAST: top/bottom rails, VERTICAL slats, large cream arrow RIGHT, four columns arrow/seams visibly shift from left towardRIGHT in quarter-cycle steps.
ROW2 NORTH: left/right rails, HORIZONTAL slats, arrow UP, four columns arrow/seams shift bottom towardTOP.
ROW3 WEST: top/bottom rails, VERTICAL slats, arrow LEFT, four columns shift right towardLEFT.
ROW4 SOUTH: left/right rails, HORIZONTAL slats, arrow DOWN, four columns shift top towardBOTTOM.
Each row four animated phases0/1/2/3, fixed outer square rails, visibly different arrow positions, every arrow always points along actual row motion. The NORTH and SOUTH frame4 slats must remain HORIZONTAL like their row's other frames; don't accidentally change slat orientation. Draw directions independently with fixed bottom-facing front edge and upper-left light. Fully isolated real transparent background, generous equal padding, no text/labels/grid lines/shadows/character. SQUARE atlas of16 SQUARE conveyors.

Create a production top-down 2D animation sprite atlas, 4 COLUMNS ×4 ROWS, exactly16 sprites. A very LOW WOODEN FLAP GATE for a square tile puzzle. This is a flat floor-level gate, NOT a tall fence. Posts must be TINY FLAT GREEN SQUARE HINGE PEGS: each peg ONLY12% of a tile across, almost no vertical column, no rope stump, no leaves or vines. The pale wood blade is a thin flat straight strip only8% of a tile thick. Bold near-black navy angular outlines, matte cream wood and sage-green hinge pegs, one flat ochre polygon shadow, clean solid-color cel art. Fixed top-down camera; only a tiny bottom-edge thickness on every object, upper-left light always. Real transparent background.
Each cell has TWO pegs fixed near opposite tile edges. Do not fill the floor. All empty areas alpha transparent.
ROW1 EAST/right. Peg centers at (50%,8%) TOP and (50%,92%) BOTTOM. Column1 CLOSED: narrow vertical blade between pegs, a big RIGHT arrow at its middle. Column2 blade rotates30degrees clockwise towardRIGHT. Column3 rotates60degrees towardRIGHT. Column4 FULLY OPEN: narrow blades fold HORIZONTALLY rightward along TOP and BOTTOM EDGES at y8% and92%; the entire middle60% cell HEIGHT is EMPTY from LEFT to RIGHT.
ROW2 NORTH/up. Pegs at (8%,50%) LEFT and (92%,50%) RIGHT. Closed thin horizontal blade with UP arrow; then30degrees towardTOP, then60degrees towardTOP; final folded blades VERTICAL along LEFT/RIGHT tile edges pointingUP, middle60% cell WIDTH EMPTY bottom-to-top.
ROW3 WEST/left. Pegs TOP andBOTTOM as row1. Closed vertical blade with LEFT arrow; rotates30 then60 towardLEFT; final blades HORIZONTAL on TOP/BOTTOM EDGES pointingLEFT, middle60% height EMPTY.
ROW4 SOUTH/down. Pegs LEFT andRIGHT as row2. Closed horizontal blade with DOWN arrow; rotates30 then60 towardBOTTOM; final blades VERTICAL on LEFT/RIGHT EDGES pointingDOWN, middle60% width EMPTY.
CRITICAL FINAL COLUMN: only two TINY hinge pegs and folded blade segments along OUTER EDGES. The central60%×60% square is completely transparent in all4 final sprites. No upright blade, detached middle plank, post or decoration there. Keep BOTH pegs and complete blade fragments in every phase. Match pegs in all phases. Include no text, headings, labels, frame grid lines, character, backdrop, drop shadows, gradients, texture/noise, glossy rendering or giant supports. Space cells generously and keep all sprites fully inside.

Precise correction to this16-sprite4×4 gate atlas. Preserve EVERYTHING except ROW2 COLUMN4 (the fully open NORTH gate at the right of the second row). In that one sprite, the two pale wood blades are currently hanging DOWN from the two small green hinge caps. They MUST extend UP from the caps, because it is a NORTH-opening gate. Draw the two small green hinge caps at the BOTTOM ENDS of the two vertical folded blades; each blade extends vertically UP along the outer left/right edges. Keep them attached and keep the middle60% width completely transparent. Do not rotate or flip any whole sprite; repaint that one north endpoint with the same fixed upper-left light and tiny bottom-facing thickness. Do not alter the south row4 endpoint: its blades must extend DOWN. No added labels, floor, text or shadows. Transparent background. Same simple flat sage peg/cream wood/navy thick outline style. Also make row1col3 and row3col3 intermediate blades visibly more open (about60degrees from closed) than col2 (30degrees), retaining the two post cap positions; every other sprite unchanged. Keep exactly4rows×4columns.
